targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1075 (diagnostic, FAIL-b as routed, claim-free). SD-PP-B5's validation, and it does not validate. As the driver scored it: A1 (inverted-rule ratio > 1.0) seeds 0/1/2/3 across margins 0.01/0.05/0.10/0.50, A4 (MSE <= 2x OFF) seeds 3/2/0/0, max MSE inflation 0.92x/5.90x/9.63x/174.19x, passing_rungs empty. TWO CORRECTIONS to that reading, both from the cells. (1) The 0.50 rung is uninformative and must be dropped from the A1 argument: its A1-passing ratios are 1.0015/1.0026/1.0109 -- within 1.1% of the value the gate module's own docstring names as DEGENERATE -- on heads with skill_vs_identity -431/-563/-675, conv_rel_drop 0.028/-1.637/0.398 and battery_mse_final/init of 0.97/2.64/0.60, i.e. at or worse than initialisation. (2) The per-seed ratio is NOT monotone in margin: seeds 42 and 123 PEAK at 0.10 and 0.05 (1.0540, 1.0258) and DECAY toward 1.0 at 0.50, which is the decay an action-independent head produces. So the honest ladder is A1 0/1/2 against A4 3/2/0 over margins 0.01/0.05/0.10. The real support for the trade is SEED-COUPLED at those two rungs: the seeds that fire A1 are the seeds whose MSE inflates (seed 123 at 0.05, ratio 1.026 with 5.90x inflation; seed 42 at 0.10, ratio 1.054 with 4.97x). The maximum ratio anywhere is 1.0540. All five non-degeneracy preconditions passed. FAIL-b survives on A4 alone, which is the one relative, control-denominated criterion.

A3 (conv_rel_drop >= 0.99) seeds: 1/1/0/0 against an ARM_OFF baseline of 1/3. max_mse_inflation 0.92 / 5.90 / 9.63 / 174.19. A2 (skill vs identity) 0/3 at every rung, falling -3.8/-13.3/-36.9/-556.4 mean by rung against ARM_OFF -5.5. passing_rungs empty. DEGENERACY: at M050 the A1-passing ratios are 1.0015/1.0026/1.0109, i.e. the gate's own documented degenerate value, on a destroyed head; max ratio anywhere is 1.0540. The gate guards a degenerate BATTERY (n_distinct_actions >= 2) but not a degenerate HEAD.
failure_record_entry.target: One margin rung with A1 met on >= 2/3 seeds BY A MARGIN excluding the degenerate ratio ~1.0 (e.g. ratio >= 1.2) AND a head-health condition (skill_vs_identity no worse than ARM_OFF), together with A4 (MSE <= 2x OFF) on >= 2/3 seeds. A3 must be RE-DENOMINATED ON THE CONTROL (conv_rel_drop >= OFF - 0.01, not an absolute 0.99) or the base first brought to V3-EXQ-1073's 0.998, because ARM_OFF clears the absolute bar on only 1/3 seeds. Separately: add a head-health guard to experiments/_lib/action_sensitivity_gate.py so a destroyed head returns cannot_determine rather than action_sensitive.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.severity_rationale: Raised from the drafted `degrading` on the A1 finding. A consumer who enables use_world_interventional at its SHIPPED DEFAULT margin 0.10 (ree_core/utils/config.py:910) gets A1 scoring 2/3 -- which reads as 'the head now passes the action-sensitivity gate' -- on a head with skill -33 to -48 and MSE inflated 5.0-9.6x. learning_extracted: SD-PP-B5 as built does NOT deliver its purpose, and more strongly than the FAIL-b label alone says. It is `implemented_pending_validation` and this run is its validation: no rung shows genuine action-discrimination at all. Its substrate_queue status must move off implemented_pending_validation.

THE A1 CRITERION CANNOT DISCRIMINATE AT THE DEGENERATE END, and was graded non-degenerate. Its bar is a bare ratio > 1.0. The gate module's own docstring names ratio == 1.0 as the degenerate value produced when permuting actions is a no-op. At M050 the A1-passing ratios are 1.0015/1.0026/1.0109 on a head with skill -431/-563/-675 and MSE 63-174x inflated: that is a head destroyed into action-INDEPENDENCE reading as action-SENSITIVE. The gate guards a degenerate BATTERY (n_distinct_actions >= 2, met at 5) and has no guard for a degenerate HEAD.

CORRECTED AT THE RED-TEAM PASS -- an earlier draft asserted 'at margin 0.10 and 0.50 the term never goes silent', which the cells flatly contradict. margin_loss_mean is 0.002-0.008% of margin at 0.01, 0.037-0.055% at 0.05, 0.077-0.100% at 0.10 and 0.68-1.04% at 0.50: the hinge is satisfied, i.e. SILENT, for essentially the whole applied-step budget at every rung. So e2_fast.py's design rationale ('the margin form goes silent once the head is separated enough', :247-248) is CONFIRMED, not falsified. What fails is its PREMISE: silence does not undo the deformation already imposed. A margin of 0.05-0.50 in z units forces predictions apart by 3.5-35x the true action-conditioned separation (~0.014 L2, from identity_predictor_mse ~1.3e-5 over world_dim 16); the head reaches that separation, goes quiet, and stays wrecked. The InfoNCE contrast ('competes with reconstruction throughout training') therefore remains OPEN rather than settled -- the margin form does not compete throughout, it deforms once and stops.

The low rung is not merely harmless, it is mildly HELPFUL, which sharpens the no-operating-point finding rather than softening it. At margin 0.01 the head's mean skill_vs_identity is -3.80 against ARM_OFF's -5.48, and A4 passes 3/3 with MSE at 0.63-0.92x OFF -- the margin term slightly IMPROVES reconstruction at low dose. And it delivers exactly zero action-sensitivity there: A1 is 0/3, ratios 0.8628/0.7026/0.7377. So the ladder has a rung that helps the head and gives no sensitivity, and rungs that give (apparent) sensitivity only by wrecking the head, with nothing in between.

A3 is a load-bearing guard its OWN CONTROL fails: ARM_OFF clears conv_rel_drop >= 0.99 on 1/3 seeds (0.98466/0.98486/0.99163). So PASS was unreachable by construction on two of three seeds -- only a margin that IMPROVED convergence over OFF could have satisfied it -- and no precondition checks that the control clears it. V3-EXQ-1073 reached 0.998 at the same P0_STEPS and LR, so this run's base is materially less converged than the run whose values justified the bar, and the driver itself records that the OFF arm does not reproduce 1073's baseline with the cause unidentified. The reconstruction verdict rests on A4, which is denominated ON the control and moves cleanly 3/2/0/0.

INSTRUMENT: STRONG ON THE APPARATUS, BLIND ON THE SUBJECT -- and the canary's scope is narrower than an earlier draft claimed. The battery-side remedies are genuinely exemplary and all held: explicit cannot_determine category, printed pre-filter denominator, N3 control-reproduction precondition, and a known-baseline canary. But the canary feeds V3-EXQ-1073's PUBLISHED (ratio, skill) pairs into readiness_verdict and checks the returned CLASS, so it certifies the classifier's threshold logic, not the measurement path (battery collection, battery_pair_ratio, the inverted env, the head). The measurement-path check is N3, and it passes on the ratio class while this run's OFF arm sits 30-100x off 1073's skill (-5.8/-2.2/-8.4 vs -0.071/+0.227/-0.007) at 0.985 convergence vs 0.998. Read as 'classifier verified; measurement path reproduces 1073's ratio class but not its skill or convergence', not as 'the negative is trustworthy'.

Cross-target with V3-EXQ-1062a -- the load-bearing convergent finding of this pair. In BOTH runs a readiness/scoring gate certifies a model that the SAME RUN's own recorded skill-vs-trivial-predictor statistic shows is broken, because in both cases that statistic was deliberately RECORDED and NOT GATED. Here A2 (skill vs identity) is 0/3 at every rung and does not gate; in V3-EXQ-1062a harm_forward_skill_vs_persistence is negative in 6/6 cells and does not gate. Each non-gating decision was locally defensible -- avoiding the over-gating that cost V3-EXQ-1062 its whole run -- but the two together produce one generalisable defect.

fires.message: bit-identical across every arm within each seed, so it cannot discriminate between arms
fires.disposition: DISMISSED -- and it is a design guarantee, not a defect.
fires.reason: identity_predictor_mse is the copy-the-input baseline computed on the FROZEN battery, whose rows and targets are bit-identical across arms by the design's own invariance property (only the trained weights differ between arms). It is a per-seed CONSTANT against which each arm's head is scored, never a discrimination criterion. Its constancy is exactly what makes skill_vs_identity comparable across arms -- had it varied, the A2 comparison would have been confounded. The discriminating quantities are action_sensitivity_ratio, conv_rel_drop and battery_mse_final, all of which vary across arms in every seed. Same shape as the C7 fire dismissed in failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1073_2026-09-22.
